Subject: Trial path selector & KPI agreement — MedFrame POC

Hi Elena —

Great speaking with you and Tom today. Quick recap and three trial paths we discussed so the team can pick the one that maps best to your constraints and timeline. I included Marissa (CS) and Sergio (SE) so they can weight in on operational items.

1) Hosted API (fastest):
- Timeline: <1 week to start (simple API keys + sample prompts).
- Scope: validate models, prompt tuning, end-to-end latency checks.
- Infra work: minimal from your side; no VPC or KMS required for PoC.
- Good when: you want rapid feature validation and no long-term data residency requirements.

2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool):
- Timeline: 2–4 weeks (capacity allocation + traffic shaping).
- Scope: predictable throughput (SLA-like behavior), cost baseline for production.
- Infra work: light network config, firewall rules, and account-level quotas.

3) Private VPC / on-prem connector:
- Timeline: 4–8 weeks (VPC peering, KMS/HSM integration, audit logging).
- Scope: full data isolation, enterprise security controls, longer procurement.
- Infra work: SRE + security time for KMS, certs, and audit log configuration.

Proposed success criteria for the trial (please confirm or edit):
- Latency: p99 generation < 250 ms for single-turn queries during normal load.
- Throughput: sustain 40–50 requests/s with <= 2x degradation under 95th percentile traffic spikes.
- Quality: average human eval score >= 4/5 on a 20-sample prompt set we’ll provide.
- Cost guardrail: estimated token-unit cost <= your internal threshold (we’ll provide expected run-rate for each path).

Next steps I propose:
- You mark the preferred path (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) — if Hosted, we’ll kick off a 2-week quickstart; if Dedicated/Private, we set a 4-week trial with a small reserved pool.
- Marissa and Sergio will draft a short runbook and an ownership RACI for the chosen path.
- I attached an initial trial-path matrix and the draft PoC plan (Drive link below).

Attachments: trial-path-matrix.xlsx (matrix), redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf (draft plan)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-medframe-poc
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/RDW-2026-MF-1093

If you’re comfortable with Hosted as a first step, we’ll schedule the kickoff for next Thursday (Dec 10). If you prefer Dedicated as the canonical evaluation, tell us and we’ll provide a week-by-week timeline and cost estimate.

Thanks —
Ben

Thanks Ben — helpful summary. Quick answers from our side:
- For the PoC we want to start with Hosted so product can validate user flows quickly. If the quality/latency meets the criteria, we’ll move to Dedicated for a 6–12 month production evaluation.
- Top priorities: latency/p99, deterministic cost estimate for 1M monthly active prompts, and KMS/SSO compatibility notes (even for Hosted, we need to understand the path to KMS).
- Timeline: Hosted kickoff next week works for us.

Can you share estimated run-rate numbers for Hosted vs Dedicated (ballpark is fine) and a short checklist for security items so I can loop in our infosec?

—Elena

> Thanks Ben — helpful summary. Quick answers from our side:
> - For the PoC we want to start with Hosted so product can validate user flows quickly...

Perfect — thanks for the direction. Quick answers and concrete next steps: 

1) Costs (ballpark):
- Hosted quickstart: expect $1.2k–$2.5k per week for the evaluation traffic profile we discussed (we’ll provide a tailored estimate with your sample prompt set).
- Dedicated small pool: one-month equivalent baseline ~ $18k–$25k depending on GPU class and QPS targets.

2) Security checklist for Hosted PoC (what we’ll provide to your infosec):
- Data residency notes (regions we serve), retention defaults and customizable retention window.
- SSO: SAML/OIDC for Redwood Console access; for API keys we can accept short-lived tokens and rotate at your cadence.
- KMS: Hosted: we support customer-managed keys for encryption at rest in our Dedicated and Private options; for Hosted we have bring-your-own-key roadmap (we can detail timeline).

Immediate next steps:
- We’ll schedule Hosted kickoff for Thu Dec 10 at 10am PT. Marissa will run the onboarding checklist; Sergio will handle sample-prompt tuning and latency baselining; Mina will collect the brief security note to share with your infosec.
- I’m attaching the trial-path-matrix again and will drop a one-page runbook before the kickoff.

Attachments: trial-path-matrix.xlsx

Ben

Subject: Internal: MedFrame runbook & stakeholder RACI (draft)

Ben — draft internal runbook and RACI below (will send clean copy to Elena before kickoff).

Runbook highlights:
- Pre-kickoff (2 days): share API keys, sample prompt set (20 queries), HubSpot deal notes.
- Day 0 (kickoff): validate connectivity, run baseline 100 sample requests to capture p50/p95/p99.
- Week 1: iterate prompts, enable continuous batching, capture cost-per-1k tokens estimate.
- Success decision at end of week 2: if latency and quality targets met, proceed to Dedicated scoping call.

RACI:
- Red: SE (Sergio) owns latency baseline and tuning.
- Yellow: CS (Marissa) owns logistics, kickoff facilitation, and success gating.
- Blue: Security (Mina) owns checklist for KMS/SSO and provides required artifacts for VPC discussion.

I’ll prepare the one-pager for the customer with the checklist and attach prior to the Thu kickoff.

-marissa
